title: trifolium michelianum subsp. balansae
intro: Trifolium michelianum subsp. balansae, commonly known as Balansa clover, is a perennial legume plant native to the mountainous regions of Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Balansa clover include its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antibacterial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
